_comment: Phase 11 — cost + health alerts, deliberately minimal (see infra/azure/README.md 'Cost + health alerts' section for what was left out and why). notificationEmail reuses the existing admin-notification address (info@akerogarden.se) rather than a new mailbox, per 2026-07-22 decision. Run any time after main.bicep — no dependency on a code redeploy. CORRECTED 2026-07-22: monthlyBudgetAmount is in SEK, not USD — this subscription bills in SEK (confirmed via `az consumption budget show ... currentSpend.unit`), and Microsoft.Consumption/budgets has no currency property to override that. The original 60 was entered assuming USD and was live for a short window; 600 SEK (~$60 at ~9.7 SEK/USD, 2026-07-22) actually covers the ~$45/mo (~440 SEK) real spend with headroom.
